record.paper_title: Conformally invariant scaling limits: an overview and a collection of problems
record.original_question: Fix κ < 8 and let γ be the SLE_κ path in the upper half-plane. Find necessary conditions, sufficient conditions, or both, on a deterministic compact set K ⊂ H that guarantee a positive probability that γ intersects K. The special case K ⊂ R is of particular interest.

evidence.quote: Problem 7.2. Fix κ < 8. Find necessary or sufficient conditions on a deterministic compact set K ⊂ H to satisfy P(K ∩ γ 6= ∅) > 0, where γ is the SLEκ path. The case K ⊂ R is of particular interest.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{H} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Im}(z) > 0\}$ denote the upper half-plane. For a parameter $\kappa \geq 0$, the chordal Schramm–Loewner evolution $\mathrm{SLE}_\kappa$ in $\mathbb{H}$ from $0$ to $\infty$ is the random curve $\gamma:[0,\infty)\to\overline{\mathbb{H}}$ whose Loewner driving function is $\sqrt{\kappa}\,B_t$, where $(B_t)_{t\geq 0}$ is a standard real Brownian motion; equivalently $\gamma$ is generated by the conformal maps $g_t:\mathbb{H}\setminus K_t\to\mathbb{H}$ satisfying $\partial_t g_t(z) = 2/(g_t(z) - \sqrt{\kappa}B_t)$ with $g_0(z)=z$.

Fix $\kappa < 8$ and let $\gamma$ denote the trace of $\mathrm{SLE}_\kappa$ in $\mathbb{H}$. Provide necessary conditions, sufficient conditions, or a characterization, expressed in terms of geometric or potential-theoretic properties of a deterministic compact set $K \subset \overline{\mathbb{H}}$, that determine whether
$$\mathbb{P}\!\left(\gamma \cap K \neq \emptyset\right) > 0.$$
The case $K \subset \mathbb{R}$ is of particular interest (note that for $\kappa \leq 4$ the curve $\gamma$ almost surely does not intersect $\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$, while for $4<\kappa<8$ the intersection with $\mathbb{R}$ is a nontrivial random fractal).
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial partial results are known but no complete necessary-and-sufficient characterization has been established. Beffara determined the almost-sure Hausdorff dimension of the SLE trace (1+κ/8 for κ≤8); Alberts–Sheffield (2008) proved that the intersection of SLE_κ (4<κ<8) with ℝ has Hausdorff dimension 2−8/κ and gave two-interval estimates; Alberts–Binder–Viklund and others have studied dimension spectra and multifractal boundary spectra for SLE_κ(ρ). These yield sharp dimension thresholds (sufficient/necessary conditions in terms of Hausdorff dimension or appropriate capacities), but a precise capacity-type characterization of hittable compact sets for general K ⊂ H or K ⊂ ℝ remains open.

status_evidence.title: Hausdorff Dimension of the SLE Curve Intersected with the Real Line (Alberts–Sheffield)
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound on asymptotic hitting probability of two small intervals; intersection of SLE_κ with ℝ has Hausdorff dimension 2−8/κ a.s. for 4<κ<8.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on boundary hitting via two-point estimates and dimension.

status_evidence.title: A Dimension Spectrum for SLE Boundary Collisions (arXiv:1501.06212)
status_evidence.snippet: Computes an a.s. dimension spectrum describing boundary collision angles for SLE_κ, κ>4.
status_evidence.claim: Further refinements but not a full hittability characterization.

status_evidence.title: A multifractal boundary spectrum for SLE_κ(ρ)
status_evidence.snippet: Multifractal spectrum of boundary behaviour of SLE_κ(ρ).
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing work on fine boundary structure; problem of characterising hittable sets not fully resolved.
